overview: You read the sheet again after Gilbert had gone. The frame, the money, and the porch were the business. The three children's lines sat above a drawing of a man with his arms out, labelled by Susanna.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the opened letter a second time and did not answer it.

parties.name: Anne Shakespeare
parties.context: Had written the roof, the money, and the porch.

parties.name: Susanna Shakespeare
parties.context: Had written the correct line and the label.

parties.name: Judith Shakespeare
parties.context: Had drawn the man with his arms out.
